title: Line Extensions and New Service Construction: Estimate Validity Period and Revision Threshold
content:
Two figures printed with every **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** estimate at Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative govern its life: the validity period, in calendar days after the estimate date, within which the line extension agreement must be signed; and the revision threshold, the percent change in the estimate from a change order above which a new estimate with a new validity period is issued.

## Figures by class

| Class of extension | Estimate validity period | Revision threshold |
|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | 90 calendar days | 10% |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | 90 calendar days | 10% |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | 90 calendar days | 10% |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | 90 calendar days | 10% |
| Irrigation Well Extension | 90 calendar days | 10% |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | 90 calendar days | 10% |
| Temporary Construction Service | 90 calendar days | 10% |

## Reading the figures

- **Validity period.** The 90 days are calendar days after the estimate date, not business days.
- **Revision threshold.** The 10 percent figure is a threshold that must be exceeded: a change order that changes the estimate by more than 10 percent is above it; a change of exactly 10 percent, or less, is not.

## Illustration (hypothetical estimate amounts)

| Current estimate | Estimate after the change order | Change | Above the 10% threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| $20,000.00 | $21,500.00 | 7.5% | No |
| $20,000.00 | $22,000.00 | 10% | No |
| $20,000.00 | $22,000.02 | just over 10% | Yes |
